live.yaml:
operator:
  namespace: storage
  reconcileInterval: 30
  useWatchAPI: true
  logLevel: INFO
  healthPort: 8080
smb:
  deploymentName: smb-server
  serviceName: smb-server
  image: crazymax/samba:latest
  workgroup: WORKGROUP
  serverString: Homelab Storage Server
  nfsMountOptions: vers=4.2,noresvport,soft,timeo=50,retrans=2
  mountReconcileInterval: 15
  initialMountWait: 30
  security:
    encryptionLevel: default
    ntlmAuth: yes
    restrictAnonymous: "1"
    disableGuestAccess: true
longhorn:
  namespace: storage
  group: longhorn.io
  version: v1beta2
  plural: volumes
resources:
  smbServer:
    requests:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 2000m
      memory: 512Mi
  operator:
    requests:
      cpu: 50m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
retry:
  maxRetries: 3
  initialDelay: 1
  backoffMultiplier: 2
  retryableStatusCodes: [409, 429, 500, 503, 504]

custom.yaml:
operator:
  namespace: files
smb:
  deploymentName: samba
  serviceName: samba-lb
  image: example/samba:1.2.3
  workgroup: HOME
  serverString: Files
  nfsMountOptions: vers=4.1,soft,timeo=30
  mountReconcileInterval: 7
  initialMountWait: 12
resources:
  smbServer:
    requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 64Mi}
    limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi}
